ui.giveIdeasAHomeStartWithASentenceThen:
# Give ideas a home

Start with a sentence, then let it grow.

## Today

- [ ] Capture an idea worth exploring
- [ ] Make time for yourself
- [x] Focus on the present

> Simple, quiet, always within reach.
